IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p137#3/r17.claim: A view transmitted by Qatada identifies the new creation as the growth of the person's hair.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p137#3/r17.anchor: وقال ابن عباس أيضا: خروجه إلى الدنيا، وقال قتادة عن فرقة:

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r1.speaker: مجاهد
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r1.claim: Mujahid says the new creation is completion of young adulthood.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r1.anchor: وقال مجاهد: كمال شبابه وقال ابن عباس أيضا: تصرفه في أمور الدنيا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas also identifies the new creation as the person's conduct in worldly affairs.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r2.anchor: وقال ابن عباس أيضا: تصرفه في أمور الدنيا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r3.claim: Ibn Atiyya rejects restricting the phrase to one stage: it broadly includes speech, perception, and adaptive ability, beginning with the spirit and reaching rational knowledge.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r3.anchor: وهذا التخصيص كله لا وجه له وإنما هو عام في هذا وغيره من وجوه من النطق والإدراك وحسن المحاولة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r4.claim: Tabāraka is the resultant form of bāraka, akin to exalted and holy in conveying blessing.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r4.anchor: مطاوع بارك فكأنها بمنزلة تعالى وتقدس من معنى البركة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r5.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r5.claim: When Umar heard the verse through its mention of a new creation, he said the concluding praise; the Prophet replied that it had been revealed that way.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r5.anchor: هذه الآية يروى أن عمر بن الخطاب لما سمع صدر الآية إلى قوله آخر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r6.speaker: معاذ بن جبل
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r6.claim: Another report names Muadh ibn Jabal as the one who said the concluding words.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r6.anchor: ويروى أن قائل ذلك معاذ بن جبل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r7.speaker: عبد الله بن أبي سرح
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r7.claim: Another account says Abd Allah ibn Abi Sarh said the words, then apostatized, claiming he could produce what Muhammad produced; this is linked to 6:93.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r7.anchor: ويروى أن قائل ذلك هو عبد الله بن أبي سرح وبهذا السبب ارتد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r8.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r8.claim: Aḥsan al-khāliqīn means the best makers; Arabic can call someone who fashions an object its creator.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r8.anchor: وقوله أحسن الخالقين معناه الصانعين يقال لمن صنع شيئا خلقه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r9.speaker: الشاعر
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r9.claim: The poetic line shows that a human maker can be said to create something and either finish or fail to finish it.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r9.anchor: ولأنت تفري ما خلقت ... وبعض القوم يخلق ثم لا يفري

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r10.speaker: ابن جريج
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r10.claim: Ibn Jurayj says God is called best of creators because He gave Jesus permission to create; others were unsettled by this wording.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r10.anchor: فقال ابن جريج: إنما قال الخالقين لأنه تعالى قد أذن لعيسى في أن يخلق

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r11.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r11.claim: Ibn Atiyya rejects denying the word creator of people when it means making; only creation by invention and bringing something from nothing is exclusive to God.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r11.anchor: ولا تنفى اللفظة عن البشر في معنى الصنع وإنما هي منفية الاختراع والإيجاد من العدم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r12.speaker: ابن عباس وعمر
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r12.claim: When elders could not answer Umar about the Night of Decree, Ibn Abbas reasoned from sevens and suggested the twenty-seventh night; Umar praised his insight.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r12.anchor: ومن هذه الآية قول ابن عباس لعمر حين سأل مشيخة الصحابة عن ليلة القدر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r13.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r13.claim: Ibn Abbas's human made from seven refers to this passage; his seven provisions refer to the produce listed in 80:27.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r13.anchor: فأراد ابن عباس بقوله خلق ابن آدم من سبع هذه الآية، وبقوله جعل رزقه في سبع قوله فأنبتنا

MUSLIM:1812/r1.author: MUSLIM
MUSLIM:1812/r1.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
MUSLIM:1812/r1.claim: Ali reports that the Prophet's prayer in prostration praises the One who created and formed him, ending with the praise, “Blessed is God, best of creators,” also found in 23:14.
MUSLIM:1812/r1.anchor: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r1.speaker: ابن كثير ونافع وأبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائي وحفص عن عاصم
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r1.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, Ḥamza, al-Kisāʾī, and Ḥafṣ from ʿĀṣim read both instances of ʿiẓām in the plural.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r1.anchor: قرأ ابن كثير ونافع وأبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائي وحفص عن عاصم عظاما فكسونا العظام على الجمع

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r2.speaker: ابن عامر وأبو بكر عن عاصم
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r2.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir and Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim read both instances in the singular, ʿaẓman and al-ʿaẓm.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r2.anchor: وقرأ ابن عامر وأبو بكر عن عاصم عظما فكسونا العظم على التوحيد

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r3.speaker: علي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r3.claim: ʿAlī says a girl is not buried alive until she passes through the seven stages of creation.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r3.anchor: قال علي عليه السلام لا تكون موؤودة حتى تمر على التارات السبع

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r4.claim: One view locates this new creation in the mother's womb.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r4.anchor: وفي محل هذا الإنشاء قولان أحدهما انه بطن الأم ثم في صفة الإنشاء قولان

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r5.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r5.claim: ʿAṭāʾ transmits from Ibn ʿAbbās that the in-womb new creation is the breathing in of the spirit; Abū al-ʿĀliya, al-Shaʿbī, Mujāhid, ʿIkrima, al-Ḍaḥḥāk, and others agree.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r5.anchor: أنه نفخ الروح فيه رواه عطاء عن ابن عباس وبه قال أبو العالية والشعبي ومجاهد وعكرمة والضحاك في آخرين

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r6.speaker: الحسن
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r6.claim: Al-Ḥasan says the in-womb creation consists of making the child male or female.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r6.anchor: أنه جعله ذكرا أو أنثى قاله الحسن

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r7.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r7.claim: A second view locates the new creation after the child leaves the mother's womb.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r7.anchor: والقول الثاني أنه بعد خروجه من بطن أمه ثم في صفة هذا الإنشاء أربعة أقوال

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r8.speaker: العوفي عن ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r8.claim: Al-ʿAwfī transmits from Ibn ʿAbbās a sequence beginning with the newborn's first cry and ability to find the breast, then development through sitting, standing, walking, weaning, puberty, and travel.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r8.anchor: أن ابتداء ذلك الإنشاء أنه استهل ثم دل على الثدي وعلم كيف يبسط رجليه إلى أن قعد إلى أن قام على رجليه إلى أن مشى إلى أن فطم إلى أن بلغ الحلم إلى أن تقلب في البلاد رواه العوفي عن ابن عباس

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r9.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r9.speaker: ابن عمر ومجاهد
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r9.claim: Ibn ʿUmar and Mujāhid say the postnatal new creation is reaching full youth.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r9.anchor: أنه استواء الشباب قاله ابن عمر ومجاهد

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r10.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r10.speaker: الضحاك
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r10.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk says the new creation is the emergence of teeth and hair; when asked about newborn hair, he pointed to pubic and armpit hair.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r10.anchor: أنه خروج الاسنان والشعر قاله الضحاك فقيل له أليس يولد وعلى رأسه الشعر فقال وأين العانة والإبط

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r11.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r11.speaker: الثعلبي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r11.claim: Al-Thaʿlabī reports the view that the new creation is the gift of reason and understanding.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r11.anchor: أنه إعطاء العقل والفهم حكاه الثعلبي

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r12.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r12.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r12.claim: Tabāraka means deserving of glorification and praise; its meaning was explained at 7:54.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r12.anchor: فتبارك الله أي استحق التعظيم والثناء وقد شرحنا معنى تبارك في الأعراف 54

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r13.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r13.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r13.claim: Aḥsan al-khāliqīn means the best shapers and estimators; khalq in Arabic can mean estimation.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r13.anchor: أحسن الخالقين أي المصورين والمقدرين والخلق في اللغة التقدير

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r14.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r14.speaker: عمر
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r14.claim: A report says the Prophet recited through “another creation,” whereupon ʿUmar uttered “Blessed is God, the best of creators”; the Prophet replied that Ibn al-Khaṭṭāb had just supplied the ending.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r14.anchor: وعنده عمر إلى قوله تعالى خلقا آخر فقال عمر فتبارك الله أحسن الخالقين فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لقد ختمت بما تكلمت به يا ابن الخطاب

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r15.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r15.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r15.claim: There is no contradiction with 35:3: creation as bringing into existence belongs only to God, while humans also shape, estimate, or make things; Zuhayr's line “khalq” witnesses estimation.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p462#3/r15.anchor: ويكون بمعنى التقدير كقول زهير ولأنت تفري ما خلقت وبعد ض القوم يخلق ثم لا يفري

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p464/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p464/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p464/r1.claim: Here, human beings can shape, estimate, and make things, so God is the best shaper and estimator.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p464/r1.anchor: فهذا المراد هاهنا أن بني آدم قد يصورون ويقدرون ويصنعون الشيء فالل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p464/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p464/r2.speaker: الأخفش
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p464/r2.claim: Al-Akhfash says khāliqūn here means makers or artisans, with God the best of makers.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p464/r2.anchor: وقال الاخفش الخالقون هاهنا هم الصانعون فالله خير الخالقين

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466/r4.claim: The drop is the emitted fluid of the man and woman; the woman's tarāʾib are chest bones from the collarbone to the breastbone, and the developing clot becomes elongated and red like a leech.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466/r4.anchor: وترائب المرأة-وهي عظام صدرها ما بين الترقوة إلى الثندوة-فصارت علقة حمراء على شكل العلقة مستطيلة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466/r5.speaker: عكرمة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466/r5.claim: Ikrima says the ʿalaqa is blood.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466/r5.anchor: صارت علقة حمراء على شكل العلقة مستطيلة. قال عكرمة: وهي دم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r1.claim: A mudgha is a morsel-sized piece of flesh with no form or markings.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r1.anchor: وهي قطعة كالبضعة من اللحم، لا شكل فيها ولا تخطيط

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r2.claim: God shapes the mudgha with a head, hands, and feet, forming its bones, sinews, and veins.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r2.anchor: يعني: شكلناها ذات رأس ويدين ورجلين بعظامها وعصبها وعروقها

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r3.speaker: آخرون
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r3.claim: Ibn Kathir notes that other readers recite the phrase as فخلقنا المضغة عظاما.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas identifies the bone as the backbone.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r4.anchor: قال ابن عباس: وهو عظم الصلب

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r5.speaker: أبو هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r5.claim: A hadith in the Sahih says every part of Adam's body decays except the tailbone, from which he was created and will be reassembled.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r5.anchor: عن أبي هريرة قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r6.claim: Flesh is placed over the bones to cover, bind, and strengthen them.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r6.anchor: أي: وجعلنا على ذلك ما يستره ويشده ويقويه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r7.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r7.claim: God then breathes the spirit into the fetus, which begins to move and becomes a new creation with hearing, sight, perception, movement, and agitation.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r7.anchor: أي: ثم نفخنا فيه الروح، فتحرك وصار {خلقا آخر} ذا سمع وبصر وإدراك وحركة واضطراب

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r8.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r8.claim: Ali says that once the drop completes four months, an angel is sent to breathe the spirit into it in the three darknesses; this is the other creation.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r8.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب، رضي الله عنه، قال: إذا أتمت النطفة أربعة أشهر، بعث إليها ملك فنفخ فيها الروح في الظلمات الثلاث

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r9.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r9.claim: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri is also reported to say that the other creation means breathing the spirit.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r9.anchor: وروي عن أبي سعيد الخدري أنه نفخ الروح

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r10.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r10.speaker: ابن عباس، مجاهد، عكرمة، الشعبي، الحسن، أبو العالية، الضحاك
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r10.claim: These authorities explain the other creation as the spirit; Ibn Kathir says this is also the interpretation chosen by Ibn Jarir.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r10.anchor: قال ابن عباس: {ثم أنشأناه خلقا آخر} يعني به: الروح

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r11.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r11.speaker: الربيع بن أنس، السدي، ابن زيد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r11.claim: Al-Rabi ibn Anas, al-Suddi, and Ibn Zayd also identify the other creation as the spirit.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r11.anchor: والضحاك، والربيع بن أنس، والسدي، وابن زيد

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r12.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r12.speaker: ابن جرير
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r12.claim: Ibn Jarir chose the interpretation that the other creation is the spirit.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r12.anchor: والربيع بن أنس، والسدي، وابن زيد، واختاره ابن جرير

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r13.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r13.speaker: العوفي عن ابن عباس، قتادة، الضحاك
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r13.claim: Another interpretation from Ibn Abbas, also reported from Qatada and al-Dahhak, takes the other creation as the successive stages of life from infancy through old age and senility.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r13.anchor: وقال العوفي، عن ابن عباس: {ثم أنشأناه خلقا آخر} يعني: ننقله من حال إلى حال

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r14.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r14.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r14.claim: The spirit interpretation and the later life-stage interpretation do not conflict, because those transitions begin once the spirit is breathed into the fetus.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r14.anchor: ولا منافاة، فإنه من ابتداء (4) نفخ الروح [فيه] (5) شرع في هذه التنقلات والأحوال

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r15.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r15.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r15.claim: The Prophet says a person develops as a drop, then a clot, then a morsel, each for forty days; an angel then breathes the spirit and records provision, lifespan, deeds, and whether the person is blessed or wretched, while final destiny can differ from the apparent course of deeds.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p466#2/r15.anchor: عن عبد الله -هو ابن مسعود-قال: حدثنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، وهو الصادق المصدوق: "إن أحدكم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r1.claim: The preceding Ibn Masud hadith is also reported by both Sahih collections through Sulayman ibn Mihran al-A'mash.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r1.anchor: أخرجاه من حديث سليمان بن مهران الأعمش

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r2.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود عن خيثمة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r2.claim: Ibn Masud says the drop spreads through every hair and nail after entering the womb, remains forty days, then descends and becomes a clot.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r2.anchor: عن خيثمة قال: قال عبد الله (8) -يعني: ابن مسعود-إن النطفة إذا وقعت في الرحم، طارت في كل شعر وظفر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r3.speaker: عبد الله عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r3.claim: In answer to a Jewish man's question, the Prophet says humans are formed from both male and female fluid: the man's thick fluid produces bones and sinews, and the woman's thin fluid produces flesh and blood; the Jew says earlier prophets taught the same.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r3.anchor: عن عبد الله قال: مر يهودي برسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وهو يحدث أصحابه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r4.speaker: حذيفة بن أسيد عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r4.claim: The Prophet says an angel enters the womb after the drop has settled for forty nights and records sex, blessedness or wretchedness, deeds, effects, misfortunes, and provision; the record is then sealed without additions or subtractions.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r4.anchor: حذيفة بن أسيد الغفاري قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r5.speaker: أنس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r5.claim: Anas reports that an angel assigned to the womb successively reports a drop, clot, and morsel; if God wills to create it, the angel asks and records sex, blessedness, wretchedness, provision, and lifespan in the mother's womb.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p467/r5.anchor: عن أنس؛ أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r1.claim: The stages display God's power and subtlety as the drop becomes a fully formed, upright human, prompting praise of God as the best of creators.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r1.anchor: من حال إلى حال، وشكل إلى شكل، حتى تصورت إلى ما صارت إليه من الإنسان السوي الكامل الخلق

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r2.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r2.claim: ʿUmar says he concurred with his Lord in four matters; after he suggested ending the creation passage with praise of God, that phrase was revealed.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r2.anchor: قال عمر -يعني: ابن الخطاب رضي الله عنه-: وافقت ربي ووافقني في أربع

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r3.speaker: زيد بن ثابت الأنصاري
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r3.claim: Zayd reports that the Prophet dictated the creation passage to him; Muʿādh supplied its closing praise, and the Prophet smiled and said that it ended with those words.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r3.anchor: عن زيد بن ثابت الأنصاري قال: أملى علي رسول الله هذه الآية

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r4.claim: Ibn Kathīr calls Jābir al-Juʿfī very weak and this report severely anomalous: the sūra is Meccan, while Zayd wrote revelation and Muʿādh embraced Islam in Medina.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p468/r4.anchor: جابر بن يزيد الجعفي ضعيف جدا، وفي خبره هذا نكارة شديدة، وذلك أن هذه السورة مكية

MUSNAD-AHMAD:729/r1.author: Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal
MUSNAD-AHMAD:729/r1.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
MUSNAD-AHMAD:729/r1.claim: Ali reports that the Prophet's prostration prayer praises God as the best of creators after saying that God created and fashioned the face and gave it hearing and sight, echoing 23:14.
MUSNAD-AHMAD:729/r1.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا كبر استفتح

MUSNAD-AHMAD:803/r1.author: Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal
MUSNAD-AHMAD:803/r1.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
MUSNAD-AHMAD:803/r1.claim: Ali reports that the Prophet's prostration prayer praises God as the best of creators after describing God's creation and fashioning of the face and its hearing and sight, echoing 23:14.
MUSNAD-AHMAD:803/r1.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا استفتح الصلاة يكبر

JISHUMI:v7p5026/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r1.speaker: ابن عامر وأبو بكر عن عاصم
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r1.claim: They read عظم and العظم in the singular, with fatḥa on ʿayn and sukūn on ẓāʾ, treating the noun as a genus.
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r1.anchor: قرأ ابن عامر وأبو بكر عن عاصم: فخلقنا المضغة عظما فكسونا العظم لحما بفتح العين وسكون الظاء

JISHUMI:v7p5026/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r2.speaker: الباقون
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r2.claim: The other readers use the plural عظام, since a human has many bones.
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r2.anchor: وقرأ الباقون [بكسر العين] وفتح الظاء على الجمع؛ لأن الإنسان ذو عظام كثيرة

JISHUMI:v7p5026/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r7.claim: In Arabic, creation means measuring; God’s acts are precisely measured to His intent without excess or deficiency, so the term is reserved for His acts.
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r7.anchor: الخلق في كلام العرب: التقدير، فلما كان جميع أفعال الله تعالى مقدرة صوابا على وفق مراده من غير زيادة ولا نقصان

JISHUMI:v7p5026/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r12.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r12.claim: ʿAlaqa is a piece of blood; ʿalaq is congealed blood, while flowing blood is masfūḥ.
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r12.anchor: والعلقة: القطعة من الدم، والعلق: الدم الجامد، وإذا خرج فهو المسفوح

JISHUMI:v7p5026/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r13.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r13.claim: The root conveys attachment and connection, including a waterskin tether and obligations attached to marriage.
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r13.anchor: ومنه علق القربة عصامها الذي تعلق بها، وفي الأمر علق وعلاقة وعلقة وعلوق ومتعلق كله بمعنى

JISHUMI:v7p5026/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r14.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5026/r14.claim: A hadith uses العلائق for obligations or bridal gifts attached to marriage.

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r1.claim: A mudgha is soft flesh that can be chewed; al-mudāgh is food being chewed and al-mudāgha what remains in the mouth.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r1.anchor: والمضغة: قطعة من اللحم التي يمكن مضغها للينها، والمضاغ الطعام يمضغ، والمضاغة ما يبقى في الفم مما يمضغ

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r2.claim: أحسن الخالقين is an adjective describing God.

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r4.claim: One account links the creation passage to prior afterlife blessings, turning to blessings at human origins and prompting reflection.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r4.anchor: لما ذكر نعمه على المؤمنين بما أعد لهم في الآخرة ابتدأ بذكر نعمه عليه ابتداء، ومنبها له على النظر في نعمه

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r5.claim: Another account says the passage identifies when resurrection occurs and shows that the One who created humans in stages can recreate them.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r5.anchor: لما بين أحوال الآخرة بين متى يكون البعث، ودل على أن من قدر على خلق الإنسان على هذا الترتيب قدر على الإعادة

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r6.claim: A third account links eternal residence in Firdaws to changing human conditions in worldly life, which God changes.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r6.anchor: لما قال: هم في الفردوس خالدون، وأحوال الإنسان في الدنيا تتغير بين أنه هو المغير

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r12.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r12.claim: The drop becomes a clotted-blood piece, then flesh, then bones which God strengthens.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r12.anchor: ثم خلقنا النطفة علقة أي: قطعة دم جامد فخلقنا العلقة مضغة أي قطعة لحم فخلقنا تلك المضغة عظاما صلبها

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r13.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r13.claim: God clothes the bones with flesh by growing flesh over them.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r13.anchor: فكسونا العظام لحما أي: ألبسنا العظام لحما، بأن أنبت عليها اللحم

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r14.speaker: ابن عباس ومجاهد والشعبي وعكرمة وأبو العالية والضحاك وابن زيد
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r14.claim: These authorities explain the new creation as the breathing of the spirit.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r14.anchor: قيل: بنفخ الروح، عن ابن عباس، ومجاهد، والشعبي، وعكرمة، وأبي العالية، والضحاك، وابن زيد

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r15.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r15.speaker: قتادة
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r15.claim: Qatada explains the new creation as growth of hair and teeth.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r15.anchor: وقيل: بنبات الشعر والأسنان، عن قتادة

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r16.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r16.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r16.claim: Other explanations are the gift of reason and understanding or completion of youth, the latter reported from Ibn ʿUmar.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r16.anchor: وقيل: بإعطاء العقل والفهم، وقيل: باستواء الشباب، عن ابن عمر

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r17.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r17.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r17.claim: Another view is the succession of states after birth: feeding, growth, maturity, reason, learning, and capacity for action.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r17.anchor: وقيل: تصريف أحواله بعد الولادة، كأنه قلبه في بطن أمه، ثم أخرجه من بطن أمه، وأطعمه من ثدي أمه

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r18.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r18.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r18.claim: A further view takes the new creation to mean becoming male or female.

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r19.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r19.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r19.claim: Tabāraka means the lasting, enduring One; baraka conveys permanence.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r19.anchor: فتبارك الله أي: الدائم الباقي، وأصل البركة: الثبوت

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r20.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r20.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r20.claim: Another gloss makes God worthy of His great attributes because He is eternal, knowing, powerful, living, hearing, seeing, rich, and just.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r20.anchor: وقيل: المستحق لعظيم صفاته بأنه قديم لم يزل ولا يزال، عالم قادر حي سميع بصير غني عدل

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r21.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r21.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r21.claim: God’s creating surpasses other agents: He creates substances, accidents, life, death, and agents, without tools or limit to His power.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r21.anchor: يعني تعالى الله أن يكون فعله كفعل سائر الفاعلين؛ لأنه يفعل الجواهر والأعراض والحياة والموت، ويخلق الفاعلين، ويخلق لا بآلة، وليس لمقدوراته نهاية

JISHUMI:v7p5028/r22.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r22.speaker: مجاهد
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r22.claim: A reported gloss takes الخالقين to mean image-makers, measurers, or makers.
JISHUMI:v7p5028/r22.anchor: قيل: أحسن أي: المصورين، وقيل: المقدرين، وقيل: الصانعين، عن مجاهد

NASAI:1126/r1.author: NASAI
NASAI:1126/r1.speaker: رسول الله
NASAI:1126/r1.claim: ʿAlī reports the Prophet’s prostration prayer: he submits to God, whose creation and fashioning of the face, hearing, and sight culminate in the verse’s praise of God, the best of creators.
NASAI:1126/r1.anchor: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم

NASAI:1127/r1.author: NASAI
NASAI:1127/r1.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
NASAI:1127/r1.claim: Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh reports a similar Prophetic prostration supplication, praising God as the best of creators after affirming God fashioned the face and gave it hearing and sight.
NASAI:1127/r1.anchor: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِهِ

NASAI:1128/r1.author: NASAI
NASAI:1128/r1.speaker: رسول الله
NASAI:1128/r1.claim: Muḥammad b. Maslama reports that during voluntary night prayer the Prophet used this prostration supplication, affirming God as Lord and praising Him as the best of creators.
NASAI:1128/r1.anchor: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ

TIRMIDHI:3421/r1.author: TIRMIDHI
TIRMIDHI:3421/r1.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
TIRMIDHI:3421/r1.claim: Ali reports the Prophet's prayer supplication, including a prostration invocation that echoes 23:14's closing praise. Al-Tirmidhi grades the report hasan sahih.
TIRMIDHI:3421/r1.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا قام إلى الصلاة قال

TIRMIDHI:3422/r1.author: TIRMIDHI
TIRMIDHI:3422/r1.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
TIRMIDHI:3422/r1.claim: Ali reports another version of the Prophet's prayer supplication, again using the verse's closing praise during prostration. Al-Tirmidhi grades it hasan sahih.
TIRMIDHI:3422/r1.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا قام إلى الصلاة قال

TIRMIDHI:3423/r1.author: TIRMIDHI
TIRMIDHI:3423/r1.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
TIRMIDHI:3423/r1.claim: Ali reports that the Prophet raised his hands at prayer's start, before bowing, after rising, and when standing from two prostrations; in prostration he recited the creation praise ending in 23:14. Al-Tirmidhi grades it hasan sahih.
TIRMIDHI:3423/r1.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب، عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

TIRMIDHI:3423/r2.author: TIRMIDHI
TIRMIDHI:3423/r2.speaker: author
TIRMIDHI:3423/r2.claim: Al-Tirmidhi says al-Shafi'i and some of his associates followed the reported hand-raising practice.
TIRMIDHI:3423/r2.anchor: والعمل على هذا عند الشافعي وبعض أصحابنا

TIRMIDHI:3423/r3.author: TIRMIDHI
TIRMIDHI:3423/r3.speaker: author
TIRMIDHI:3423/r3.claim: Al-Tirmidhi reports that Ahmad did not endorse the described hand raising.
TIRMIDHI:3423/r3.anchor: قال أبو عيسى وأحمد لا يراه

TIRMIDHI:3423/r4.author: TIRMIDHI
TIRMIDHI:3423/r4.speaker: author
TIRMIDHI:3423/r4.claim: Some Kufan and other scholars held that the gesture belongs in voluntary prayer, not obligatory prayer.
TIRMIDHI:3423/r4.anchor: وقال بعض أهل العلم من أهل الكوفة وغيرهم يقول هذا في صلاة التطوع ولا يقوله في المكتوبة

TIRMIDHI:3423/r5.author: TIRMIDHI
TIRMIDHI:3423/r5.speaker: سليمان بن داود الهاشمي
TIRMIDHI:3423/r5.claim: Sulayman al-Hashimi compares this report to the well-known report of al-Zuhri from Salim from his father.
TIRMIDHI:3423/r5.anchor: سمعت سليمان بن داود الهاشمي يقول وذكر هذا الحديث فقال هذا عندنا مثل حديث الزهري عن سالم عن أبيه

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r5.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r5.claim: The ʿalaqa is fresh blood formed from the drop, named for being the first stage of attachment.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r5.anchor: العلقة الدم الطري الذي خلق من النطفة سمي علقة لأنه أول أحوال العلوق

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r6.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r6.claim: A mudgha is an amount of flesh about the size of a morsel to be chewed.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r6.anchor: وهي قدر ما يمضغ من اللحم

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r7.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r7.claim: The stages of human formation display God's favor and wisdom; resurrection is easier than creating a person alive after he was nothing.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r7.anchor: ليعلم نعمته عليه وحكمته فيه , وإن بعثه بعد الموت حيا أهون من إنشائه ولم يكن شيئا .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r8.speaker: ابن عباس والكلبي
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r8.claim: They interpret the new creation as the breathing of the spirit into the formed body.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r8.anchor: أحدها : يعني بنفخ الروح فيه , وهذا قول ابن عباس والكلبي .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r9.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r9.claim: Qatada says the new creation is the growth of hair.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r9.anchor: الثاني : بنبات الشعر , وهذا قول قتادة .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r10.speaker: الحسن
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r10.claim: Al-Hasan interprets the new creation as the child's becoming male or female.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r10.anchor: الثالث : أنه ذكر و أنثى , وهذا قول الحسن .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r11.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r11.claim: Mujahid identifies the new creation with attaining full young adulthood.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r11.anchor: الرابع : حين استوى به شبابه , وهذا قول مجاهد .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r12.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r12.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r12.claim: He proposes a fifth possibility: the acquisition of reason and discernment.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r12.anchor: ويحتمل وجها خامسا : أنه بالعقل والتمييز .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r13.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r13.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r13.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas, through Saʿid ibn Jubayr, reports that when the passage through the new-creation clause was revealed, ʿUmar said the closing praise, after which that clause was revealed.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p48/r13.anchor: قال عمر بن الخطاب : فتبارك الله أحسن الخالقين فنزلت : { فتبارك الله أحسن الخالقين } .

MUJAHID:v2p429#2/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p429#2/r1.speaker: مجاهد
MUJAHID:v2p429#2/r1.claim: Mujahid explains the later creation as the human becoming fully grown in youth.
MUJAHID:v2p429#2/r1.anchor: عن ابن أبي نجيح عن مجاهد في قوله ﴿ ثم أنشأناه خلقا آخر ﴾ يعني استوى شبابا

MUQATIL:23:12-14/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:23:12-14/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:23:12-14/r5.claim: The fluid changes into blood; the blood then changes into flesh like a morsel, followed by bones covered with flesh.
MUQATIL:23:12-14/r5.anchor: يقول: تحول الماء فصار دما { فخلقنا العلقة مضغة } يعنى فتحول الدم فصار لحما مثل المضغة

MUQATIL:23:12-14/r6.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:23:12-14/r6.speaker: author
MUQATIL:23:12-14/r6.claim: The “other creation” is the spirit, breathed into the body after its physical creation.
MUQATIL:23:12-14/r6.anchor: يقول: خلقناه، { خلقا آخر } يعنى الروح ينفخ فيه بعد خلقه

MUQATIL:23:12-14/r7.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:23:12-14/r7.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
MUQATIL:23:12-14/r7.claim: Before the Prophet finished the verse, ʿUmar recited its closing words; the Prophet told him, “Thus it was revealed, ʿUmar.”
MUQATIL:23:12-14/r7.anchor: فقال عمر بن الخطاب، رضى الله عنه: قبل أن يتم النبى صلى الله عليه وسلم الآية: { تبارك الله أحسن الخالقين }

MUQATIL:23:14-18/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:23:14-18/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:23:14-18/r1.claim: God is the best image-maker compared with those who make statues and other things that cannot move.
MUQATIL:23:14-18/r1.anchor: يقول: هو أحسن المصورين، يعني من الذين خلقوا التماثيل وغيرها التى لا يتحرك منها شىء

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r1.claim: Here khalaqna means made or transformed, since it takes two objects, unlike khalaqa in its usual sense, which takes one.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r1.anchor: أى صيرناها بدلالة تعديه إلى مفعولين والخلق يتعدى إلى مفعول واحد

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r2.claim: An alaqa is a piece of blood; the white semen becomes red blood.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r2.anchor: قطعة دم والمعنى أحلنا النطفة البيضاء علقة حمراء

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r3.claim: A mudgha is flesh about the size of a chewed morsel.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r4.claim: The embryo is made into bones, then flesh is grown over them like clothing.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r4.anchor: فصيرناها عظاما ﴿ فكسونا العظام لحما ﴾ فأنبتنا عليها اللحم فصار لها كاللباس

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r5.speaker: الشامي وأبو بكر وزيد عن يعقوب وأبو زيد
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r5.claim: On the bones wording, Shami and Abu Bakr have the singular azman; Zayd from Yaqub reads the definite plural, while Abu Zayd has the definite singular, used for the plural without ambiguity because humans have many bones.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r5.anchor: العظم شامى وأبوبكر عظما العظام زيد عن يعقوب عظاما العظم عن أبى زيد

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r6.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r6.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r6.claim: The pronoun can refer to the human being or to the thing just mentioned.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r6.anchor: الضمير يعود إلى الانسان أوإلى المذكور

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r7.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r7.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r7.claim: This is a distinct new creation: God makes a living animal from inanimate matter, with speech, hearing, and sight after their opposites.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r7.anchor: خلقنا مباينا للخلق الأول حيث جعله حيوانا وكان جمادا وناطقا وسميعا وبصيرا

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r8.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r8.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r8.claim: If a usurped egg hatches while in someone's possession, the person owes the egg but does not return the chick, since it is a new creation distinct from the egg.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r8.anchor: إذا غصب بيضة فأفرخت عنده يضمن اليضة ولا يرد الفرخ لأنه خلق آخر سوى البيضة

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r9.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r9.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r9.claim: God is exalted in His power and knowledge.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r10.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r10.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r10.claim: Ahsanu is an apposition or the predicate of an omitted subject; it is not an adjective because a comparative noun remains indefinite despite annexation, whose second term stands in place of min.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r10.anchor: بدل أو خبر مبتدا محذوف وليس بصفة لأنه نكرة وان أضيف لأن المضاف إليه عوض من من

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r11.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r11.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r11.claim: Khaliqin here means estimators or planners; the omitted taqdīran is understood from the word.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r11.anchor: المقدرين أى أحسن المقدرين تقديرا فترك ذكر الممين لدلالة الخالقين عليه

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r12.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r12.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r12.claim: An account says the Prophet's scribe Abd Allah ibn Sad ibn Abi Sarh uttered the phrase before it was dictated; after the Prophet said to write it as revealed, he claimed he too received revelation, apostatized, fled to Mecca, and later accepted Islam at its conquest.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r12.anchor: وقيل إن عبدالله بن سعد بن أبو سرح كان يكتب للنبى عليه السلام فنطق بذلك قبل املائه

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r13.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r13.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r13.claim: Nasafi rejects that story as unsound: the apostasy occurred in Medina, whereas this sūra is Meccan.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r13.anchor: وقيل هذه الحكاية غير صحيحة لأن ارتداده كان بالمدينة وهذه السورة مكية

NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r14.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r14.speaker: عمر أو معاذ
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r14.claim: Another report attributes the phrase to Umar or Muadh.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p118/r14.anchor: وقيل القائل عمر أو معاذ رضى الله عنهما

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r3.claim: Qurtubi refers meanings and legal rulings about the drop, clot, and morsel to his earlier commentary on Sūrat al-Ḥajj.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r3.anchor: قد مضى القول في النطفة والعلقة والمضغة وما في ذلك من الأحكام في أول الحج

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas, al-Shaʿbī, Abu al-ʿĀliya, al-Ḍaḥḥāk, and Ibn Zayd say the new creation is the breathing of the spirit into previously inert matter.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r4.anchor: ابن عباس والشعبي وأبو العالية والضحاك وابن زيد: هو نفخ الروح فيه بعد أن كان جمادا

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r5.claim: A separate report from Ibn Abbas identifies the new creation as emergence into the world.

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r6.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r6.claim: Qatada transmits from a group that the phrase means the growth of the child’s hair.

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r7.speaker: الضحاك
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r7.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk says the phrase refers to teeth emerging and hair growing.

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r8.speaker: مجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r8.claim: Mujahid, also reported from Ibn Umar, interprets the phrase as reaching full youth.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r8.anchor: مجاهد: كمال شبابه وروي عن ابن عمر

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r9.claim: Qurtubi prefers a general sense encompassing these stages and others: speech, perception, skill, acquiring intelligible knowledge, and development through death.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r9.anchor: والصحيح أنه عام في هذا وفي غيره من النطق والإدراك وحسن المحاولة وتحصيل المعقولات إلى أن يموت

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r10.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r10.claim: One report says Umar heard the passage through “a new creation,” uttered the closing phrase, and the Prophet replied that it was revealed that way.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r10.anchor: أن عمر بن الخطاب لما سمع صدر الآية إلى قوله: { خلقا آخر } قال فتبارك الله أحسن الخالقين

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r11.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r11.claim: In al-Ṭayālisī’s Musnad, Umar says he uttered the phrase when the creation passage was revealed, after which the matching verse was revealed.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r11.anchor: وفي مسند الطيالسي: ونزلت { ولقد خلقنا الإنسان من سلالة من طين } الآية فلما نزلت قلت أنا:

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r12.speaker: معاذ بن جبل
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r12.claim: Another report attributes the utterance to Muʿādh ibn Jabal.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r12.anchor: ويروى أن قائل ذلك معاذ بن جبل

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r13.speaker: عبد الله بن أبي سرح
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r13.claim: A report attributes the phrase to ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Sarḥ, who then apostatized, claiming he could produce what Muhammad produced; Qurtubi links the matter to 6:93.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r13.anchor: وروي أن قائل ذلك عبد الله بن أبي سرح

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r14.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r14.claim: Tabāraka is a derived form from baraka, blessing.

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r15.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r15.claim: Aḥsan al-khāliqīn means the most exact or accomplished makers.

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r16.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r16.claim: People may be called creators for manufacture; an anonymous poet contrasts completing what one makes with making but failing to finish it.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r16.anchor: يقال لمن صنع شيئا خلقه ومنه قول الشاعر: ولأنت تفري ما خلقت

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r17.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r17.claim: Some deny applying “creator” to people, reserving the word for God.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r17.anchor: وذهب بعض الناس إلى نفي هذه اللفظة عن الناس وإنما يضاف الخلق إلى الله تعالى

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r18.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r18.speaker: ابن جريج
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r18.claim: Ibn Jurayj says God is the best of creators because He permitted Jesus to create.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r18.anchor: وقال ابن جريج: إنما قال: «أحسن الخالقين» لأنه تعالى قد أذن لعيسى عليه السلام أن يخلق

QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r19.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r19.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r19.claim: Qurtubi allows “creating” for human manufacture but reserves creation from nothing for God.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:12-14/r19.anchor: ولا تنفى اللفظة عن البشر في معنى الصنع وإنما هي منفية بمعنى الاختراع والإيجاد من العدم

IBNMUJAHID:v1p444/r3.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p444/r3.speaker: ابن عامر، عاصم عن أبي بكر
IBNMUJAHID:v1p444/r3.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir and Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim read عظم and العظم singular, without alif before mīm; the others use plurals.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p444/r3.anchor: فقرأ ابن عامر وعاصم فى رواية أبى بكر / فخلقنا المضغة عظما فكسونا العظم / واحدا ليس قبل الميم ألف
